''' Umbriss's estate''' was an estate the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Umbriss]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] owned around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, the estate was taken by one of his superiors, a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] by the name of [[Darth Angral]], when Umbriss incurred Angral's wrath and was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Angral claimed his opponent's wealth and possessions as his own, including Umbriss's estate and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Sadic]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Umbriss's estate has its first and only mention alongside its owner in the [[2011]] video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which features an in-game Codex. The entry for Umbriss's apprentice, Lord Sadic, detailed his demise and how Darth Angral acquired Sadic as an apprentice.<ref name="Codex" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] players receive this entry after defeating Sadic in the class mission "Showdown with Lord Sadic" on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Showdown">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Showdown with Lord Sadic|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
